title: The Crypto ATM
intro: A text, a phone call, and now instructions. Someone wants Toddy at a crypto ATM.
Crypto ATM scams have grown fast.
Read the instructions. Sniff every line.

notify.text: Unpaid tax. Pay today at a crypto ATM to avoid arrest.

msg.text: Pay today at the crypto ATM on Market Street
Scan this QR code at the machine
Failure to pay means arrest tonight.
Do not call us. Reply here only.

atm.label: Pay at a crypto ATM
atm.lens: A government office telling you to use a crypto ATM.
atm.why: No tax office or government takes payment through crypto ATMs.

qr.label: Their QR code
qr.why: Money sent through it is gone.

arrest.label: Arrest threat
arrest.why: Threats of arrest are a pressure trick.

nocall.label: Don't call us
nocall.why: Real offices are happy for you to call them.

owe.label: Surprise debt
owe.lens: A debt you've never heard of.
owe.why: Real tax offices send letters first and give time to check.

sender.label: Official name
sender.why: Text sender names can be faked.

actions.label: Go to the ATM and pay
Call the tax office on the number from its official website
Report the text as spam and block it

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. Your phone network flagged the sender.

verify.line: The real tax office: "You owe nothing. We never ask for crypto."

go_ahead.line: The ATM turned the cash into crypto and sent it straight to Mirage.

what_if.go_ahead: A government office telling you to use a crypto ATM is always a scam.

golden_rule: No government, bank or company will ever ask you to pay at a crypto ATM.

quick_check.q: Someone tells you to pay a bill at a crypto ATM. What is it?
quick_check.explain: Crypto ATM payments go straight to scammers and can't be reversed.

hints.nudge: How do they want the money?

rows.v: One you have never heard of
Real offices want you to check
